---
title: "Folder Tree and Ownership Boundaries"
---

## Intended repository tree

```text
scgsim/
├── README.md                 # SCGSim Development-owned package entry
├── _quarto.yml               # SCGSim Development-owned site configuration
├── _extensions/              # SCGSim Development-owned vendored Quarto extensions
├── docs/                     # SCGSim Development-owned authored Quarto sources/assets
├── src/scgsim/               # SCGSim Development-owned product source
├── schemas/                  # SCGSim Development-owned product schemas
├── scripts/                  # SCGSim Development-owned producers/tooling
└── tests/                    # SCGSim Development-owned stabilization tests
```

Generated site output is never source authority.

## Responsibility map

| Owner | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| SCGSim Development | Package/build/runtime/report source, schemas, tests, scripts, CI/release, README, Quarto site configuration and extensions, authored documentation and assets, information architecture and prose, generated-reference placement/presentation |
| OrPen SC PDK | Public PDK facts, public Component source, and public component-simulation notebooks |
| Chip Design EPR | Surface-EPR requirements and private consumer validation only |
| `scq-ansys-aedt` | Version-locked AEDT/PyAEDT procedure only; no repository path ownership |
| Integration & Sync | Repository settings, merges, future pins, synchronization, and cleanup |

Generated API reference may be produced from product-owned source, while its
placement and presentation remain package-owned. No owner listed here may
infer Human acceptance, publication authority, or merge authority from a green
build.
